beats.shot: Land on /upload. Cursor drifts toward the page title, settles near the dropzone.
beats.vo: This is the Upload workbench, where every order enters ProcuLink.

beats.shot: Cursor traces the dropzone format line (CSV, XLSX, PDF, XML, EDI), then rests on Browse files.
beats.vo: You can drop a purchase order here in whatever format it already lives in. A CSV, a spreadsheet, a PDF, or structured formats like cXML, UBL, EDIFACT and X12. ProcuLink detects the format for you.

beats.shot: Cursor glides down to the sample-order chip and hovers the 'Try with a sample order' button. No click.
beats.vo: No order handy yet? The sample order runs a safe example through the whole flow, and it never counts toward your monthly quota.

beats.shot: Cursor returns to Browse files, clicks; a CSV file 'arrives'. Detect pill appears: Detected CSV, PO number, line count, 'seen this layout before'.
beats.vo: Let's add a real file. The moment it lands, ProcuLink identifies the format, the purchase order number, and the line count. And if it has seen this layout before, it tells you.

beats.shot: Cursor moves to the Pipeline configuration panel, opens the supplier select and switches to ElectroSupply Co; the 'routes to' line updates.
beats.vo: Every upload routes to one supplier. Pick the one this order is for. Their format and delivery settings are what ProcuLink will use later, when the order is sent.

beats.shot: Cursor clicks 'Upload & review'. The Parse, Normalize, Validate stage animation plays.
beats.vo: Then upload. ProcuLink parses the file, normalizes it into one canonical order, and runs the first validation checks.

beats.shot: The mapping preview page lands: parsed lines with AI suggestions visible. Cursor rests; no interaction.
beats.vo: And this is what happens next. The parsed order opens for review, line by line. Nothing is ever sent to a supplier without passing through review first. That's the next guide.
